verdict.rationale: Segment's Engage docs confirm that audiences can be built from tracking events (behavior), traits, and computed traits, then synced to hundreds of destinations. That covers the core segmentation-and-activation part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows the builder is a visual, no-SQL interface for marketers, or that audience size can be previewed before activating. Missing for 10: evidence of a visual no-code builder, an audience size estimate or preview before activation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
